stages.definition: Existing Nepal format and discovery only.
Reviewed country contract, fail-closed reference intake and structural checks; no production data release.

Current rights-cleared Nepal federal office/local-unit and ward assignments with five/seven-digit string codes, separately namespaced legacy editions, original script and explicit source relations. Require source/terms versions, retrieval times and SHA-256; reproducible real-row coverage, ambiguity and temporal validation; an approved published immutable artifact re-downloaded and verified through the actual AGID loader/API. Administrative geometry needs independent permission, source identifiers and an explicit postal crosswalk, otherwise geometry none with no coordinate-lookup claim; label any derived or virtual region separately. Exact civic numbers and buildings need independent permitted explicit relations. Neither arithmetic ward expansion, historical UPU examples, table counts, source names, PDFs nor synthetic tests establish national coverage, delivery validity or M2.
Independent holdout, multilingual ambiguity, temporal/coverage and explicit civic/building relationship checks pass.
Repeated refresh, corrections, freshness monitoring and verified rollback under reviewed permissions.

agid_integration.current_scope: Nepal address-format syntax and metadata-only source discovery. NP remains disabled in the generic Postal Context runtime.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A real rights-cleared immutable scoped pack must pass the actual loader/API before country enablement. Source names, URLs and structure-only checks are not address validation.
agid_integration.agid_cell_rule: Cell identity is a spatial index, not assignment or building identity.
